root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: input->base_after == input->base_before when buf->error is set
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When xmlBufUpdateInput observes a buffer error on the live parser input, it must preserve the current parser base pointer instead of rebinding input->base to the empty-string sentinel before QName parsing resumes.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable malloc-failure path truncates input->base to "" and later reuses the stale NCName offset against that sentinel. In the vulnerable original trace, base_before != base_after and the protected QName lookup executes. In the fixed original trace, base_before == base_after at the same buf->error event and the protected QName lookup still executes.

nodes.state: At the QName dictionary-lookup call, the recombined lookup pointer equals BASE_PTR + 1, so the stale startPosition has advanced the rebased parser base to the first byte past the sentinel buffer.

The hash loop sink dereferences its incoming data pointer directly; the vulnerable sink event occurs on the same propagated pointer value recorded at the last dict_lookup_internal -> hash_name_sink transition.

edges.relation: The parser BASE_PTR used at the QName dictionary-lookup call is the same input->base value last written by xmlBufUpdateInput on the malloc-failure path.
The same stale NCName offset captured before xmlParserGrow is the offset later recombined with BASE_PTR at the QName dictionary-lookup call.
xmlParseNCNameComplex forwards the recombined lookup pointer unchanged as the name argument to xmlDictLookupInternal.
xmlDictLookupInternal passes the same propagated name pointer directly into xmlDictHashName as the data pointer later dereferenced by the hash loop.
